terbaru.judul: Three Different Ways Synchronization Can Cause Contagion in Financial Markets
terbaru.pelajaran: We introduce tools to capture the dynamics of three different pathways, in which the synchronization of human decision-making could lead to turbulent periods and contagion phenomena in financial markets.

terbaru.judul: Divestment may burst the carbon bubble if investors' beliefs tip to anticipating strong future climate policy
terbaru.pelajaran: Using a stochastic agent-based model of co-evolving financial market and investors' beliefs about future climate policy on an adaptive social network, here we find that the dynamics of divestment from fossil fuels shows potential for social tipping away from a fossil-fuel based economy.

terbaru.judul: A Comparison of Economic Agent-Based Model Calibration Methods
terbaru.pelajaran: We find that Bayesian estimation, though less popular in the literature, consistently outperforms frequentist, objective function-based approaches and results in reasonable parameter estimates in many contexts.

terbaru.judul: Development of an agent-based speculation game for higher reproducibility of financial stylized facts
terbaru.pelajaran: In this study, by extending the decision-making structure of Minority Game, we propose a novel agent-based model called "Speculation Game," for a better reproducibility of the stylized facts.

terbaru.judul: An Agent-Based Model to Explain the Emergence of Stylised Facts in Log Returns
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper outlines an agent-based model of a simple financial market in which a single asset is available for trade by three different types of traders.

terbaru.judul: Co-existence of Trend and Value in Financial Markets: Estimating an Extended Chiarella Model
terbaru.pelajaran: Trend and Value are pervasive anomalies, common to all financial markets.

terbaru.judul: A simplified model based on self-organized criticality framework for the seismic assessment of urban areas
terbaru.pelajaran: The analysis of the seismic vulnerability of urban centres has received a great attention in the last century.

terbaru.judul: Modeling of the parties' vote share distributions
terbaru.pelajaran: We show that most of the time empirical vote share distributions could be well fitted by numerous different distributions.

terbaru.judul: Second order stochastic differential models for financial markets
terbaru.pelajaran: We propose some simple second order models, including a stochastic constrained n-oscillator, which can explain many market phenomena, such as boom-bust cycles, stochastic quasi-periodic behavior, and "hot money" going from one market sector to another.

terbaru.judul: A fractional reaction-diffusion description of supply and demand
terbaru.pelajaran: We propose a fractional reaction-diffusion model for the dynamics of latent liquidity in financial markets, where agents are very heterogeneous in terms of their characteristic frequencies.
